resources.string: Control other devices with the keyboard and mouse connected to this phone

KemaHub receives input from the keyboard and mouse connected to this device and sends it to the Bluetooth device (PC, tablet) you choose with a hotkey. When this phone is selected, input is left as it is. Input is never stored or sent to the internet; it only goes to the device you choose. KemaHub does not read screen content.
Use the keyboard and mouse connected to this phone to control PCs and tablets nearby. Nothing needs to be installed on them.
This phone connects to your devices as a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse.
Needed to receive input from the connected keyboard and mouse and pass it to the device you choose.
Shows that KemaHub is running and which device you are controlling.
Can\'t turn on KemaHub? App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings
How KemaHub uses the accessibility service
KemaHub uses the accessibility service only to:
• Receive input from the keyboard and mouse connected to this phone.
• Send that input to the Bluetooth device (PC, tablet) you select with a hotkey. While this phone is selected, input is left as it is.
• Input is never stored and never sent to the internet or to the developer. It only goes to the device you select.
• KemaHub does not read screen content.
On the next screen, turn on KemaHub under Installed apps (or Downloaded apps).
Starts as a copy of the current profile.
Tap a number to choose the device on it. The modifier keys are set in Settings.
If the device is on another hotkey, the two swap.
On your PC or tablet, add this phone from the Bluetooth settings. New devices go to the next free hotkey of the profile in use.
Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Add device → Bluetooth → select this phone
Not listed? Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Devices → set \"Bluetooth devices discovery\" to Advanced, then try again.
System Settings → Bluetooth → click Connect next to this phone
If this phone asks to pair, allow it. Keep this phone\'s Bluetooth settings screen closed while connecting.
The accessibility service is off. Turn on KemaHub in the accessibility settings.
Stopped because the accessibility service was turned off.
This phone does not support Bluetooth.
This phone cannot act as a Bluetooth LE keyboard (peripheral mode not supported).
Could not start the Bluetooth keyboard service. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then try again.
Turn on to use this phone\'s keyboard and mouse on your devices.
Profiles whose conditions match switch on by themselves; when several match, the higher one wins. Drag ☰ to reorder. When none match, the profile you activated last is used.
You activated %1$s, so it is used instead of %2$s until the conditions change.
Choose the devices that switch this profile on. Without any, the profile is used only when you activate it.
Pairing mode is on. Add this phone on your PC or tablet.
No paired devices yet. Turn on pairing mode to add one.
Turn on to add a new PC or tablet. While it\'s off, only paired devices can connect.
A name for this device in KemaHub.
Remove \"%1$s\"? It is unpaired and removed from every profile. Also remove this phone on that device.
Briefly show which device you switched to
This log helps the developer look into problems. It has the app\'s events and device names, never what you type. Sending opens your email app addressed to the developer.
Android hides the on-screen keyboard while a physical keyboard is connected. This shows it again while the physical keyboard controls another device, so you can still type on this phone.
Hold these keys and press a number: 1 for this phone, 2–9 and 0 for devices 1–9. The same in every profile.
Applies while any of the checked devices is connected. Paired devices nearby reconnect by themselves while hosting is on.
Uses the profile with the most of its devices connected; ties go to the higher profile.
Uses the first profile, in list order, one of whose chosen devices is connected.
Uses only the profile you activate.
These conditions are used only when profile activation is rule-based (Settings).
The profile with the most of its devices connected is used; ties go to the higher one. Drag ☰ to reorder. With none connected, the profile you activated last is used.
The profile you activate is used. Drag ☰ to reorder.
In both automatic modes, when nothing matches, the profile you activated last is used. Activating a profile by hand also overrides the automatic choice until the connected devices change.
